title: Token Utility for On-Policy Distillation via Local Trust-Region Optimization
abstract_tex: Token-selection methods for on-policy distillation (OPD) prioritize student-visited positions using diverse signals, including uncertainty, teacher–student disagreement, and mismatch direction. We instead derive token importance from the distillation objective itself: how much can each position's loss decrease under an equal local KL budget on the student's predictive distribution? The answer is the utility $s_t=g_t^\top F_t^\dagger g_t$, where $g_t$ is the logit gradient and $F_t$ is the categorical Fisher matrix. For reverse-KL it equals the student-weighted variance of the student–teacher log-probability ratio, and for forward-KL it equals the Pearson $\chi^2$ divergence, so the appropriate utility follows from the choice of objective. On shared training checkpoints, several independently motivated criteria, including student entropy, KL disagreement, and TIP, concentrate their importance on nearly the same positions as the derived utility at a 50\% selection fraction, while diverging at stricter fractions and for direction-specific criteria. We instantiate the utility as Fisher Utility Weighting (FUW), a continuous, mean-normalized token weighting. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3 student–teacher pairs, FUW improves over matched uniform OPD under both reverse-KL (1.35–4.0 macro points) and forward-KL (1.08–2.71 macro points), and is competitive with existing selective methods using a single closed-form score derived from the training objective.

evaluation.macro: Equal mean over seven benchmark accuracies.
evaluation.pooled: Equal mean over all 1620 problem accuracies, regardless of sampled-response count.
evaluation.uncertainty: Each configuration is trained once; uncertainty reflects paired bootstrap resampling over evaluation problems. Aggregate uncertainty and paired contrasts use 20000 paired bootstrap resamples.
evaluation.source_precision_note: Reverse-KL table headings say Avg@8 although the four smaller benchmarks use 16 responses and the larger three use eight. Forward-KL Table 7 uses Avg@k and explicitly identifies ± values as standard error.

protocol.matching: Uniform OPD, FUW, and TIP use the same union-top-16 candidate support and restricted renormalized loss. TIDE uses its native support.

claims: An equal infinitesimal KL budget induces a Fisher-geometry token utility directly from the distillation objective.
Reverse-KL utility is the student-weighted variance of the student–teacher log-probability ratio; forward-KL utility is Pearson χ²(pT || pS).
FUW improves macro and pooled accuracy over matched uniform OPD across all three evaluated model pairs under both objectives.
FUW has the highest aggregate trained-student point estimates for the two 1.7B pairs; TIDE has slightly higher aggregate estimates for the 4B pair.
At 50% selection, several criteria have near-complete effective-support agreement along the uniformly trained 1.7B ← 14B trajectory, while TIDE-excess stays distinct.
Permuting FUW weights lowers pooled accuracy by 1.02 percentage points (paired p = 0.028), supporting position-specific utility information.
caveats: The KL trust region derives the score and is not imposed as a constraint during training.
The theory concerns independent local predictive distributions, not globally optimal shared-transformer parameter updates.
The training score uses clipped, renormalized restricted support; it approximates full-vocabulary utility.
Effective-support agreement does not imply identical rankings, selected sets, or weight vectors; agreement at 20% is criterion- and checkpoint-dependent.
FUW versus TIP pooled difference for the 1.7B ← 8B pair has a paired-bootstrap 95% CI including zero.
Euclidean utility has comparable downstream accuracy (p = 0.527); FUW versus hard top-half weighting is not significant (p = 0.087).
Each configuration is trained once; uncertainty is evaluation-bootstrap uncertainty, not independent training-seed variation.

controls.interpretation: Negative paired differences favor FUW. Exact controls precision is retained; do not replace the main-table FUW39.2 by39.17.
